english.title: PHV operator fail keep records of vehicles and drivers available - London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a London private hire vehicle, failed to keep at a specified operating centre, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OPERATING CENTRE..), the prescribed records of particulars of the private hire vehicles and drivers which were available to you for carrying out bookings accepted by you at that centre
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(3)(d) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes:
(i) Section 4(4) provides that if a London PHV operator ceases to use an operating centre specified in his licence he shall preserve any record he was required by this section to keep there for such period as may be prescribed.
(ii) Section 4(6) provides a defence in proceedings for this offence for an operator to show that he exercised all due diligence to avoid committing such an offence.
